Name: Slime Hutch Restored
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
A simple mod that makes the Slime Hutch bigger and brings back the classic look.

Why would you make this? So I could use retexture mods made for the classic Slime Hutch.

Maybe people can use/edit this to make an optional version for their classic retexture?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img] Buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/dollymods]coffee[/url] if you want to help me make more mods [img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img]
